text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, I noticed 
Stay Gold had stopped, gazing out at the 
sunset.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Takes me back. It looks just like the 
sunset I saw on that plateau.
choice_data_list:
Highlands... Are you talking about our 
trip?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Though it was far wider than the sky 
we can see from here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It felt like my entire vision was filled 
with the colors of the sunset in an 
instant. It was a feeling unlike anything 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps the mood struck her, because 
after talking about the sunset, Stay Gold 
decided to tell me stories about her 
journeys."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—Oh right, there were so many magnificent 
buildings here. The geometric patterns and 
symmetrical designs really caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The colors were truly captivating as well. 
It had a lustrous sheen, and the gold was 
beautiful. Plus, there was a river in the 
center of town—ah, here's the photo.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Along with historical buildings, the 
photos captured a gentle river flowing 
under a blue sky, and parks lush with 
nature.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! When you see it in person, the 
thrill will blow this completely out of 
the water.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Still, talking like this...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Memories of our journey so far surface one 
after another. A sense of nostalgia, and a 
touch of longing.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. This feeling is one of the joys 
of traveling.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"It gives me a push on the back, saying 
'just once more.' That's the itch to 
travel for ya."
choice_data_list: Just hearing about it makes me want to go!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Right? Besides, while the food and the 
scenery are great parts of traveling, when 
it comes down to it—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"In a grassland that seemed to stretch on 
forever, there lived a people in peaceful 
harmony."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Welcoming me as a traveler, they guided me 
to their tent. They treated me to food, 
prepared a bed for me, and sang songs for 
me to hear.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hands, feet, plates, glasses, the earth 
itself— everything turned into an 
instrument making music.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't understand their language, but 
we managed to share our names. Even now, 
that name is the one thing I still 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"I once saved someone who was drowning in 
a seaside town."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
She felt ashamed that she couldn't swim 
despite being born in this town, but—

text_block_list.name: Seaside Town Woman
text_block_list.text:
Still, I have no intention of leaving this 
town. It's where I was born and raised, 
and besides...

text_block_list.name: Seaside Town Woman
text_block_list.text:
"When I close my eyes tiredly, the sound 
of the waves and the scent of the ocean... 
I really, really love it."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
She laughed, saying it was for such a 
trivial reason, but to me, it felt like 
something truly important.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"And then—there were some thrilling trips 
too. I asked for a shop to buy water, and 
ended up being led into some sketchy 
nightclub."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Surrounded by a crowd, I assumed it was 
some kind of trouble, but—

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
It's a traveler, you guys! Give 'em a warm 
welcome! Water, booze... wait, juice, 
maybe? I'll give ya whatever you want!

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text:
Haha! A traveler like you helped me out 
once before. Consider this returning the 
favor!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
When she was injured, an unnamed traveler 
apparently came to her aid. And told her 
to pay that kindness forward to the next 
traveler in need.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"In an unfamiliar land, I was saved by a 
stranger who wasn't even there―― a 
traveler, in other words."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Stay Gold, who told me stories about the 
many people she had encountered."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Trivial everyday events, acts of kindness, 
helping someone, and being helped by 
others.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There were many memories embedded within 
her "journey."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
They often say every encounter is 
once-in-a-lifetime, don't they? I've never 
had a second encounter with most people, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, that encounter... became an 
indelible memory of my journey."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, it might sound like an exaggeration, 
but it really does feel fitting.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...What about you, Trainer? What kind of 
places would you like to travel to?
choice_data_list: A famous tourist spot could be nice too.

Like a hidden paradise no one's ever been 
to

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sightseeing spots are places where many 
people gather. It seems we can look 
forward to meeting lots of people there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The fact that it's become a tourist spot 
means there are probably plenty of things 
worth seeing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
While we're at it, it might be fun to ask 
the locals about places that aren't listed 
in any books.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it... in a secret spot 
the locals told me about long ago, there 
was a dried-up spring—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Stay Gold, who spared no detail in 
sharing her travel tales. I felt as though 
I had gotten a little taste of traveling 
myself."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll have to start by searching. 
Since no one has ever been there, 
information is practically nonexistent.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case... I suppose the first 
step is a journey to find information.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like a long journey, but the 
sense of accomplishment when you arrive 
must be truly irresistible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking fondly of unseen lands, I had an 
animated chat with Stay Gold about 
travel."
